channel.title: The Global Meridian – International News Wire
channel.description: Authoritative, verified global journalism from international news bureaus across Geneva, Tokyo, Washington, London, New Delhi, and Dhaka.

item.title: US Aviation Recovers After Historic FAA Ground Stop as Shenzhen Confirms Nov 19 Trump-Xi-Putin Trilateral
item.description: Air travel across the United States resumes normal schedules following only the second nationwide FAA ground stop since 2001, as diplomats finalize November 19 US-China-Russia summit talks in Shenzhen.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Bangladesh Stages Historic 206-Run Test Fightback vs South Africa as Towhid Hridoy Hits 137 & Litton Unbeaten 92
item.description: Rescuing the Tigers from 22 for 3 against Kagiso Rabada in Johannesburg, Towhid Hridoy and Litton Das power Bangladesh to 327 for 6 on Day 1 as Mosaddek Hossain sets a domestic double-ton record.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Japan Economy Contracts 0.1% in Q3 as Cox’s Bazar ADB Debt Conference Tackles Bangladesh’s $113B External Obligations
item.description: Fresh cabinet data shows Japan’s Q3 GDP dipped unexpectedly on household cost pressures while Bangladesh and the ADB convene international debt experts in Cox’s Bazar amid Gazipur industrial talks.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: AI Coding Security Spotlight: Cursor Third-Party Key Breach and $4B Norwest Fund Fuel "Agentic Cybersecurity"
item.description: A third-party vendor key compromise exposing a trojanized Claude Code extension underscores supply-chain risks as Norwest launches a $4B fund and Cohere names Jaya Baloo as CISO.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: Bangladesh’s Runa Khan Receives 2026 Ramon Magsaysay Award in Manila Amid Domestic Security Focus in Dhaka & Gopalganj
item.description: Friendship NGO founder Runa Khan accepts Asia’s premier humanitarian honor in Manila even as Dhaka authorities step up law-and-order monitoring following localized unrest in Gopalganj.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Tanker Mine Strikes Near Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb Troop Realignment Escalate Maritime Alert
item.description: Iran’s Revolutionary Guard reports two oil tankers struck mines near the Strait of Hormuz as Yemeni government forces withdraw from Bab el-Mandeb positions to reinforce Aden.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: NASA’s Voyager 1 Nears Historic One Light-Day Milestone 26 Billion Kilometers from Earth
item.description: Nearly 50 years after launch, Voyager 1 approaches a 24-hour radio signal distance from Earth alongside breakthroughs in Caltech autonomous robotic space assembly and MIT-Harvard’s Lumina cosmic simulation.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Mercedes Clinches 9th F1 Constructors’ Crown as Messi Wins Back-to-Back MLS Golden Boot
item.description: George Russell and Kimi Antonelli seal Mercedes-Benz’s ninth Formula One team title in São Paulo while Lionel Messi sets an MLS record with 26 goals for consecutive Golden Boots.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: World Prematurity Day 2026: WHO Urges Expanded NICU Care for 15 Million Preterm Infants Amid DR Congo Ebola Strain
item.description: On November 15, the World Health Organization calls for stronger neonatal follow-up care globally while UN responders warn conflict is hindering Ebola containment in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Orbital Data Centers & MIT AI Climate Emulators Spark Global Tech Policy Debate in Late 2026
item.description: As Innovation for Cool Earth Forum warns space-based compute governance lags behind hardware launches, MIT and Stanford unveil ultra-fast AI models for climate and laser physics.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: Sandip Ray Launches Four-Story Satyajit Ray Anthology Shoot as "Godzilla Minus Zero" Surges Worldwide
item.description: Veteran director Sandip Ray adapts iconic classics Khagam, Batik Babu, Bhuto, and Neel Atanka with an all-star Bengali cast while global box-office buzz builds around Godzilla Minus Zero.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Abu Dhabi Trilateral Talks Open as Europe Demands Seat at Table Over US-Brokered Ukraine Security Proposals
item.description: US envoys open direct talks with Ukrainian and Russian representatives in Abu Dhabi while Kyiv and European capitals push back against proposals threatening post-Cold War borders.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Bangladesh Wins 3-Year LDC Graduation Extension to 2029 as Dhaka Presses Climate Justice at COP31 Antalya
item.description: Following UN approval shifting graduation to November 2029, economists urge structural tax and banking reforms while Prime Minister Tarique Rahman champions adaptation grants in Türkiye.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Central Banks Face Dual Macro Shock: Fed and BoE Weigh Sticky Energy Inflation Against AI Capex Boom
item.description: Policymakers at the Federal Reserve, Bank of England, and ECB navigate a rare economic split where volatile oil prices fuel inflation fears while massive AI data-center spending sustains growth.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Satellite Intelligence Shows Iran Rebuilding Strategic Missile Sites Amid Heightened Western Arms Interdiction
item.description: Commercial orbital imagery analyzed by international defense monitors reveals accelerated reconstruction at Garmdareh, Shahroud, and Parchin alongside stepped-up overland enforcement.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: Spain’s First General Strike in 14 Years Sparks Debate Over Housing Crisis and Snap Election Politics
item.description: Millions join demonstrations over housing affordability and wages in an unusual political mobilization widely analyzed across Europe as a prelude to snap parliamentary elections.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: Analysis: Central Asia Emerges as Vital Eurasian Trade Corridor Amid Supply Chain Fragmentation and Sanctions
item.description: Strategic intelligence reports highlight surging rail, port, and critical-mineral investments across Central Asia as global manufacturers diversify away from single-route chokepoints.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: White House Announces Unprecedented US-China-Russia Trilateral Summit at APEC for Strategic Nuclear Talks
item.description: Washington confirms preparations for a rare three-way leadership meeting between US, Chinese, and Russian presidents on the sidelines of the APEC summit focused on strategic arms stability.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)

item.title: WMO Warns at COP31 Antalya That 2026 Ranks Among Warmest Years Amid Super El Niño and Record Ocean Heat
item.description: As UN climate talks in Antalya enter week two, the World Meteorological Organization reports record-breaking ocean temperatures, rising sea levels, and urgent EU climate-health action.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: OECD Projects 2.9% Global Economic Growth in 2026 Driven by AI Infrastructure Boom as UK Expands 0.7% in Q3
item.description: Sustained capital expenditures in data centers, power grids, and enterprise AI outpace energy volatility, lifting UK third-quarter output to its fastest pace in over two years.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: Industry Shifts Toward "Physical AI" as Autonomous Robotics and Grid-Scale Compute Capex Surge Worldwide
item.description: Enterprise technology leaders move beyond chat interfaces to deploy agentic software and embodied robotics across semiconductor fabs, logistics ports, and scientific laboratories.
item.author: m.vance@meridian-news.org (Marcus Vance)

item.title: WEF and Frontiers Spotlight Direct Lithium Extraction, Grid-Interactive EVs, and Personalized mRNA Cancer Vaccines
item.description: Joint international scientific assessment highlights three breakthrough technologies moving from laboratory prototypes to commercial global scale in 2026.
item.author: t.mansoor@meridian-news.org (Dr. Tariq Al-Mansoor)

item.title: Strait of Hormuz Maritime Security Alerts Intensify as Global Allies Review Strategic Defense Posture and Satellite Resilience
item.description: Heightened naval monitoring across Middle Eastern shipping lanes coincides with accelerated multi-year defense modernization plans and orbital reconnaissance deployments.
item.author: j.moreau@meridian-news.org (Julian Moreau)

item.title: SAFF Championship: Defending Champions India Edge Bhutan 2-1 to Reach Regional Football Final
item.description: A spirited second-half performance seals India's berth in the South Asian Football Federation championship decider after a fiercely contested semifinal.
item.author: a.chowdhury@meridian-news.org (Aisha Chowdhury)

item.title: International Film Festival of India Sets 159 Global Films Under "Stories Without Borders" Theme Ahead of Goa Opening
item.description: The 57th IFFI opens Nov 20 with Paweł Pawlikowski's Cannes-winning "Fatherland" alongside 159 international selections chosen from over 1,400 global submissions.
item.author: e.rostova@meridian-news.org (Elena Rostova)
